_comment: 🧩️ This owner's contribution. gis3d's editor-config artifact (Gis3dConfig, camera_json+locale, session-only view state — never document history) carries one typed mutation vocabulary (set-camera, set-locale), mounted directly from this facet's own leaves. Claimed by mutate-gis-gisterrain-1-config beside this file.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: `Gis3dConfig` (`../🦀️.rs`) is gis3d's own session-only editor view-state — a free/live viewport camera (`cameraJson`) and a UI locale tag, explicitly NEVER part of the document's undo history (see this file's own module doc comment). There is no third-party implementation of this repository's own ephemeral editor state and no third party could hold an opinion about it: what is under test is that `set-camera` and `set-locale` are each a WHOLE-FIELD replace that leaves its sibling field untouched (mirroring `gisterrain`'s own `os-config-opening-preferences-mutation-semantics` sparse-update precedent, `../../../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🎚️config/🧪️oracle/🔣️.json`), and that each kind's own computed inverse restores the pre-mutation record exactly — statements about this repository's own editor-state semantics, not about JSON or string storage. Confidence comes from `gis3d_config_mutation_report_json` (`../🦀️.rs`) exercising the REAL, unconditional `Mutation<Gis3dConfig>`/`MutationDiff<Gis3dConfig>` trait implementations `#[derive(dsl::Mutations)]`/`#[derive(dsl::MutationLeaf)]` already generate for `Gis3dConfigMutation`/`SetCamera`/`SetLocale` — the identical trait chain this file's own `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` already asserts against directly — and from the inverse law as a metamorphic property, checked directly in the claiming feature's own subject handler rather than deferred to an oracle role this vocabulary has none of.

provenance.attribution: A minimal, deterministic set-camera specification vector over Gis3dConfig's own two-field record ({cameraJson, locale}), matching this feature's own Examples table row verbatim and this facet's own no-oracle decision (gis-gisterrain-config-mutation-semantics) — no tool or third-party library produced it, it is asserted correct by construction against the same real Mutation<Gis3dConfig>/MutationDiff<Gis3dConfig> trait chain gis3d_config_mutation_report_json (../🦀️.rs) exercises, exactly as os.config.opening's own committed specification vectors are.
